body.name: Q
body.type: finite rational planted normalized quadratic-system encoding
body.def: A binary string encoding \(m\), a finite ordered list of constraints of the forms \(x_i=c\), \(x_i=x_j+x_k\), \(x_i=x_jx_k\), \(x_i=x_j\), \(x_i=0\), and \(x_i=1\), with every rational constant \(c\) stored as a signed binary numerator and positive binary denominator in lowest terms, together with a selector index and a planted rational vector.
body.role: source instance for the hardness reduction
